newsitem.title: UKRAINE: TABLE-Ukraine Jan-July GDP falls 6.9 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Ukraine Jan-July GDP falls 6.9 pct year/year.

text.p: Ukraine's gross domestic product (GDP) in the first seven months of this year was about 47.596 billion hryvnias, 6.9 percent lower than a year earlier, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday. UKRAINE GDP Jan-July 97 Jan-June 97 Jan-July 96
The government is forecasting growth of 0.5 percent in 1998 after a fall of 3.0 percent over the whole of this year. GDP contracted 10.0 percent in 1996.
